page.layout: One printed page, upside down. Only show-through from the title leaf on the other side is visible, with a library stamp, handwritten shelf marks and a manuscript annotation at the foot.
page.notes: No text on this side is legible as the page's own print. The upright, mirrored lettering at top and middle (title and imprint block) is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The faint upside-down line at the foot, which appears to read as an imprint ("Excudebat ... Anno 1596"), cannot be read letter by letter, so I have not transcribed it. Left out: the oval "Bibliotheca Genevensis" library stamp, the handwritten "11/3316" shelf mark, and the pencil/ink marks at lower centre and right.
